# Argus — full context for LLMs

> Argus is a **cloud verification platform** for AI coding agents. It runs real Chromium on Cloudflare
> (Browser Rendering + Durable Objects) and exposes it as `argus_*` MCP tools: lease a session, drive
> the app, read **program truth** (network, console, route, app signals, store state), assert with
> evidence tiers, and save deterministic flows that replay with no model in the loop.

Argus is **self-hosted** — you deploy the Worker to your own Cloudflare account and wire each project
with `argus init`. There is no hosted signup. The MCP server is plain stdio and works with any MCP
client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code/Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Cline, Zed).

## What it is

- **Interfaces:** an MCP server (`packages/mcp`, stdio), a CLI (`packages/cli`), an HTTPS API on a
  Cloudflare Worker (`packages/cloud`), and an optional app-side SDK (`packages/sdk`).
- **Checks:** smoke (load, console/network clean, responsive overflow, screenshots) · flows
  (recorded, semantically anchored, deterministically replayed) · audit (axe-core a11y, FCP/LCP/CLS,
  broken links, overflow, pixel-diff visual regression).
- **Evidence tiers:** signal > consequence (network/route/state/storage) > dom > visual. A verdict reports the
  **weakest tier** it rests on — never upgraded. Missing evidence is `coverage: partial`, never a
  quiet pass. Unresolvable anchors are errors, never guesses.
- **Predicates** cover `network`, `console-clean`, `route`, `storage`, `visible`/`hidden`/`text`,
  `signal` and `state`, and compose recursively with `allOf` / `anyOf`.

## How it is used

1. **Agent, in-session.** `argus init <api-url> <token>` wires the MCP server into the detected
   harnesses and writes standing verification steps into `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`. The
   `argus-explore` skill drives discovery; `verify-change` re-verifies after edits.
2. **CI / GitHub.** Install the GitHub App and commit `.argus/platform.json`; every pull request (or
   preview deployment) runs the selected suites and posts an **Argus Verification** Check Run with a
   verdict, findings, and a 24-hour signed evidence page.
3. **CLI / deploy gate.** `argus verify <url>` runs smoke + audit + every saved flow, exiting non-zero
   on failure. `argus gate --upload` verifies a Worker version before it takes traffic.
4. **Any MCP client.** The server returns its lifecycle as `instructions` on initialize, so a client
   that surfaces them needs no instruction file at all.

## Tools (24, `argus_*`)

Sessions: `argus_lease`, `argus_release`, `argus_sessions`, `argus_auth_save/list/delete`.
Drive/read: `argus_query`, `argus_act`, `argus_act_batch`, `argus_observe`, `argus_assert`,
`argus_screenshot`.
Verify: `argus_smoke`, `argus_audit`, `argus_runs`, `argus_findings`.
Flows: `argus_record`, `argus_flow_save/list/replay/verify/heal`, `argus_flow_import_reticle`.
Discovery: `argus_tools` (the full surface, flagging which tools yield a verdict).
Mail/magic links: `argus_email_link`.

Only `argus_assert` and a flow's `expect` / `success` predicates produce a verdict — `argus_act`
moves the app and proves nothing.

## What it does not do

- **No source `file:line` mapping.** Findings carry an optional `whereInSource`, but Argus does not
  walk React fibers back to source; there are no Babel/Next/Vite instrumentation plugins.
- **No state-library adapters.** `@argus/sdk` offers a generic `registerStore()` + `signal()`; TanStack
  Query, Jotai, XState, Valtio, MobX, Recoil, Svelte stores and Pinia have no shipped adapter.
- **No React commit stream / render-storm detection.**
- **No WebSocket/SSE frame observation.** The network ring buffer holds request/response events.
- **No desktop (Electron/Tauri) capture.**
